titleEn: Ordering a Pizza by Phone for Pickup
titleZh: 电话订披萨并到店自取
desc: 电话订披萨时，练习确认自取、尺寸、配料、饼底、取餐时间和订单姓名，自然完成整通电话。

sceneSetup.en: Aria calls a pizza shop, places a customized order for pickup, and confirms the preparation time, order name, and payment timing.
sceneSetup.zh: Aria 打电话给披萨店，定制一份到店自取的披萨，并确认制作时间、订单姓名和付款时间。

learningGoal.en: Choose pickup, order a size and toppings, add extras, confirm the order, and ask when it will be ready.
learningGoal.zh: 学会选择自取、说明尺寸和配料、添加额外餐品、确认订单并询问取餐时间。

dialogue.speaker: Pizza Shop
dialogue.en: Will this be for pickup or delivery?

dialogue.speaker: Aria
dialogue.en: I'd like to order one pizza.

dialogue.speaker: Aria
dialogue.en: Can I get half pepperoni and half mushrooms and green peppers?
dialogue.zh: 可以一半放意大利辣香肠，另一半放蘑菇和青椒吗？

dialogue.speaker: Pizza Shop
dialogue.en: Would you like regular or thin crust?
dialogue.zh: 你想要普通饼底还是薄饼底？

dialogue.speaker: Aria
dialogue.en: And could I get one garlic dipping sauce?
dialogue.zh: 另外可以加一份蒜香蘸酱吗？

dialogue.speaker: Pizza Shop
dialogue.en: One large, regular crust pizza, half pepperoni,
dialogue.zh: 一个大号普通饼底披萨，一半意大利辣香肠，

dialogue.speaker: Pizza Shop
dialogue.en: half mushrooms and green peppers with one garlic dip.
dialogue.zh: 另一半蘑菇和青椒，再加一份蒜香蘸酱。

dialogue.speaker: Pizza Shop
dialogue.en: It should be ready for pickup in about 25 minutes.
dialogue.zh: 大约二十五分钟后可以取餐。

dialogue.speaker: Pizza Shop
dialogue.en: Can I get a name for the order?

dialogue.speaker: Pizza Shop
dialogue.en: You can pay when you pick it up.

tips.title: pickup or delivery
tips.body: Asks how the customer wants to receive the order.
tips.bodyZh: 询问顾客想自己取餐还是需要配送。

tips.title: Pickup, please.
tips.body: A short, natural answer when collecting the order yourself.
tips.bodyZh: 表示自己到店取餐时简短自然的回答。

tips.title: I'd like to order…
tips.body: A polite way to begin stating an order.
tips.bodyZh: 礼貌开始说明订单内容。

tips.title: What size would you like?
tips.body: Asks the customer to choose a size.
tips.bodyZh: 询问顾客想选择什么尺寸。

tips.title: half pepperoni and half mushrooms
tips.body: Describes two topping combinations on one pizza.
tips.bodyZh: 说明同一个披萨两边使用不同配料。

tips.title: regular or thin crust
tips.body: Two common crust choices offered by pizza shops.
tips.bodyZh: 披萨店常见的两种饼底选择。

tips.title: one garlic dipping sauce
tips.body: A polite way to add an extra item.
tips.bodyZh: 在订单中添加额外餐品。

tips.title: No, that's everything.
tips.body: A natural response when the order is complete.
tips.bodyZh: 确认不再添加餐品时的自然表达。

tips.title: Let me confirm…
tips.bodyZh: 复述订单、确认内容准确时的开场。

tips.title: How long will it take?
tips.body: Asks about preparation or waiting time.

tips.title: ready for pickup
tips.body: Means the order is prepared and can be collected.
tips.bodyZh: 表示订单已经做好、可以到店领取。

tips.title: a name for the order
tips.body: The name used to identify the order.

tips.title: Confirm the complete order
tips.body: Listen for the staff to repeat the size, crust, toppings, and extras. Then confirm the pickup time, order name, and payment timing.
tips.bodyZh: 电话订餐时，可以留意店员是否完整复述尺寸、饼底、配料和额外餐品。确认无误后，再问取餐时间、订单姓名和付款方式。
